name: Puerto Rico Open 2024

venue.name: Albergue Olimpico

information:
With help from Puerto Rican Speedcubers (PRSC) and Team Nub LLC, we are happy to share the second official Puerto Rican Cubing Competition!

¡Con la ayuda de Puerto Rican Speedcubers (PRSC) y Equipo Nub LLC, estamos felices de anunciar la segunda competencia oficial de Cubing en Puerto Rico!

This competition is in partnership with Team Nub LLC
